settings.title: Turns Hours of Scrubbing into Minutes
settings.description: High-torque motor that spins the brush heads up to 350 RPM, breaking down soap scum, mildew, and grime without scrubbing by hand.

settings.title: Reaches Every Corner
settings.description: Extendable handle and multiple brush heads let you clean hard-to-reach areas like shower ceilings, grout lines, and tight corners effortlessly.

settings.title: Safe on All Surfaces
settings.description: Gentle yet effective bristles work on tile, glass, porcelain, and more without scratching or damaging your bathroom surfaces.
